) (
   input wire                logic [D0_IDX_SIZE-1:0] addr0,

                  output reg [31:0] PWDATA);

  always @(posedge PCLK or negedge PRESETn) begin
    if (!PRESETn) begin
      state <= IDLE;
    end else begin
      case (state)
        IDLE: begin
          if (Transfer) begin
            state <= SETUP;
          end
        end
        SETUP: begin
          PSELx <= 1'b1;
          PENABLE <= 1'b1;
          PADDR <= Address;
          PWRITE <= Wr_Rd;
          PWDATA <= write_data;
          state <= ACCESS;
        end

          if (PREADY) begin
            if (PSLVERR) begin
              state <= IDLE;
            end else begin
              if (Transfer) begin
                state <= SETUP;
              end else begin
                read_data <= PRDATA;
                state <= IDLE;
              end
            end
          end
        end
      endcase
    end
  end
